{{Quote|Can you tell me how to get to Margess Base?''"<br />"''You planning on driving a landspeeder after sixteen mugs of Corellian whiskey?''"<br />"''Ahh&hellip;''(Waves hand.)'' I didn't drink sixteen mugs of Corellian whiskey.''"<br />"''It's a good thing you didn't drink sixteen mugs of Corellian whiskey. Just head west out over Autumna Planitia.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a [[Unidentified bartender (Corellian whiskey)|bartender]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>}}
'''Corellian [[Whiskey/Legends|whiskey]]''' was a popular [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. One particularly favored brand was [[Whyren's Reserve/Legends|Whyren's Reserve]], especially the [[NN182]] vintage. Corellian whiskey was a prime ingredient in traditional [[Ryshcate/Legends|ryshcate]], along with [[Vweilu nut]]s. The whiskey had a woody, spicy flavor that was similar to the scent of [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]].

[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] whiskey was primarily popular among Corellians themselves. Despite its popularity with them, most Corellians not actually living on Corellia itself tended to reserve the drink for special occasions, due to its rarity and prohibitive expense elsewhere in the galaxy. Possibly in response, distillers on worlds colonized by Corellians, such as the [[Ethra Brewery]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], started producing their own versions.

Corellian whiskey could be sold by the mug. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once drank sixteen mugs of Corellian whiskey while trying to get information out of a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Corellian whiskey)|bounty hunter]]. He used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Detoxify Poison|nullify]] the effects of the [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]]. When the [[Unidentified bartender (Corellian whiskey)|bartender]] questioned the fact that Skywalker was going to drive a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] to [[Margess Base]] after drinking so much, Skywalker used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them otherwise.<ref name="TRG1-77">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

[[Cade Skywalker]] ordered a Corellian whiskey (along with [[Corellian ale/Legends|Corellian ale]]) at [[Rik's Cantina/Legends|Rik's Cantina]] in [[137 ABY]]. [[Gerd]] preffered to drink his Corellian whiskey sour.
